official_sources.title: Revit API PointCloudType.GetReCapProject
official_sources.finding: Returns ReCap SDK RCProject; documented example calls RCProject.GetNumberOfPoints() for the total point count.

official_sources.title: Autodesk Reality Solutions SDK
official_sources.finding: SDK reads and writes RCP/RCS; availability is through Autodesk Developer Network/Reality Solutions SDK.

official_sources.title: Autodesk ReCap RCS file format support
official_sources.finding: Autodesk directs users to Reality Solutions SDK for RCS/RCP file information.

local_evidence.reflection_query: Assembly.GetExportedTypes() did not return before command timeout; no SDK invocation or point-count value obtained.
local_evidence.revit_2027_revitapi_xml: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2027\RevitAPI.xml documents Autodesk.Revit.DB.PointCloudType.GetReCapProject; AdskRcManaged.dll is present beside RevitAPI.dll.

conclusion: A documented Autodesk point-count method exists, but it has not yet been run against station 761317. The current RCP NumPoints vs native-reader discrepancy therefore remains unresolved and does not prove point loss.
next_step: The installed Revit 2027 XML confirms PointCloudType.GetReCapProject and the required AdskRcManaged.dll is present. Run the documented RCProject.GetNumberOfPoints() against the same source RCS inside a licensed Revit API host, then compare its result to RCP NumPoints and SCAN native iteration.
